releases.notes:
Build automatique du commit cc28b16fca05a67545608dfd05b4011c5face4dd (branche `claude/sleepy-knuth-41qkf5`).

Make the mod compile for Minecraft 26.2 through a small compat layer

Minecraft 26.2 moved screens to Gui, titles/overlay/chat to Hud, replaced
GuiGraphics with GuiGraphicsExtractor, dropped EditBox filters and Fabric
renamed KeyBindingHelper to KeyMappingHelper. These calls now go through
compat.Compat / compat.BaseScreen, implemented once per Minecraft
version; the rest of the code is shared. Also removes the temporary API
dump workflow.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01T4FynBNnBXSzJf9szW6Tkh

Deux fichiers, prenez celui de votre version de Minecraft :
- `autofarm-1.0.30+1.21.11.jar` : Minecraft 1.21.11 (Java 21+)
- `autofarm-1.0.30+26.2.jar` : Minecraft 26.2 (Java 25+)

Installation : Fabric Loader + Fabric API pour votre version de Minecraft, puis mettre le .jar dans `mods/`.

Detect private messages using » (and other arrows), normalise small-caps text

The server formats private messages as "[Sender » moi] ..."; only ->, →
and ➡ were recognised. Small-caps / stylised letters are normalised to
plain ASCII before matching.

Farm statistics from the server's chat, with a dedicated stats screen

- Money and crops from the harvest reports only (event money is already
  included there), rewards from "Tu as reçu/obtenu/gagné" lines detected
  generically, events counted by occurrence.
- Session and persistent all-time totals, per-hour rates.
- Stats screen (L key or menu button) with per-row show/hide, on-screen
  panel toggle, phone summary mode (never / on stop / periodic), resets.
